title: Prechallenge bound read-policy commitment
domain: one fixed P/I/K/event/consumer binding, Boolean full-factorial challenges and the declared one-port polarity twin family T_1
conditional_conclusion: Within T_1, a consumer-bound read policy witnessed before an independently drawn challenge and blind to all pre-read challenge cues cannot mimic AND/OR with one fixed port/polarity mode; public finite challenges without this package are exactly mimickable.
open_bridge: Actual SEPP installation and complete K remain absent; C1/R157 transport is conditional; B_pc^family, H_cf, measurement, report and subject count remain open.
proof_role: For each four-row target, 16 of 256 challenge-indexed policies are exact mimics and zero of four fixed one-port policies are; three drop-one constructions delimit the evidence package.
